title: Amelia Rose Exported A Vibrant Single Track, "Falling Down"
htmlContent:
Amelia Rose and Cocabona are a dynamic pop, soul, jazz, and R&B duo from the United Kingdom and Finland, respectively. Amelia, a 22-year-old singer, combines her hauntingly beautiful voice with Cocabona's masterful production and multi-instrumental skills to create a unique sound that's both moody and chill.

 Their latest single, "Falling Down," showcases the depth of their creative talent, delivering a mesmerizing performance showcasing the raw emotion and passion both artists bring to their music. 

With a growing fanbase and a reputation for producing music that touches the soul, Amelia Rose and Cocabona are an act that you don't want to miss.
